test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The judge asked the prisoner if he had anything to say for himself.

options.text: The judge said to the prisoner, "Does he have anything to say for himself?"
The judge said to the prisoner, "If you have anything to say for yourself?"
The judge said to the prisoner, "Did he had anything to say for himself?"
The judge said to the prisoner, "Do you have anything to say for yourself?"

solution:
The correct answer is: The judge said to the prisoner, "Do you have anything to say for yourself?"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an **indirect speech **to** direct speech**, we must follow these **rules**:
 
 
• The reporting verb **'asked'** changes to **'said'**.
 
• The reporting verb is changed according to reported speech into asking if the sentence asks for an answer.
 
• A **comma (,)** is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in **capital letters**.
 
• The conditional **'if'** changes to an asking verb **'Do'**.
 
• The pronoun **'you'** changes to **'he'**.
 
 

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. 

**Hence, direct speech is-** *The judge said to the prisoner, "Do you have anything to say for yourself?"*
